messages:
Lina Torres: Proposing Argos Therapeutics private rollout for 2026-04-05 01:00 UTC. Starting preflight now. Main items: KMS rotation at 00:10 UTC and ensuring model pin to redwood-inference:v4.0.1 across slices.
DeployBot: deploy request accepted tenant=argos-thera env=private image=redwood-inference:v4.0.1 rollout=progressive-slices
Priya Nair: KMS rotate currently scheduled 00:10 UTC 1 change might be needed. If rotation rewraps keys we should leave a 50m buffer before starting rollout.
Elaine Cho: I'll validate rotation type with Security. If it's rewrap-only we can keep the window but shift start to 01:15 UTC to be safe.
OpsBot: canary slice planned: canary-01 size=1gpu expected_ramp=7m metrics=p50,p95,4xx,kvcache_eviction,cpu%
Sam Wu: Release notes draft: https://confluence.redwood/argos/v4.0.1 - highlights: improved quantized attention kernel, faster decoding, KV cache race fix. Fallback to v3.9.8 available.
Lina Torres: Need explicit rollback gates: immediate rollback if p50 > 200ms increase over baseline for 2 consecutive minutes OR 5xx rate > 0.2% sustained 4m. Early alert: KVCACHE evictions > 18% sustained 10m.
Priya Nair: +1. Also request disk i/o and host-level swap be monitored during canary ramp.
Elaine Cho: Security: rotation is a rewrap only (no revocation). We can schedule rotation at 00:10 UTC. Recommend rollout start 01:15 UTC for a 65m buffer. audit entry will be created.
Security-Bot: audit event created id=evt-20260405-argos-kms-01 retention=90d
Lina Torres: OK shifting start to 01:15 UTC. Priya, Elaine, Sam please ack and I'll enqueue.
Priya Nair: Ack. Approving window and rollback thresholds.
Elaine Cho: Approved.
Sam Wu: Approved from product side. No significant behavioral regressions on our A/B prompt suite.
Lina Torres: Queuing rollout. DeployBot will report slice progress here.
DeployBot: rollout queued -> slice 1/6 scheduled ETA 01:25 UTC
DeployBot: slice 1/6 started at 2026-04-05T01:25:00Z
Lina Torres: smoke: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/tenants/argos/predict -d '{"prompt":"ping"}'` -> 200 OK, latency 92ms
DeployBot: slice 1/6 success metrics within thresholds
DeployBot: slice 2/6 started
DeployBot: slice 2/6 notice: p95 elevated by +180ms for 4m, notifying ops
OpsBot: investigating slice-2 p95 increase 1 checking cache warmup, network jitter, and runtime threads
Priya Nair: Observed higher CPU steal on one host; live-migrating affected pod to another host.
DeployBot: slice-2 recovered after pod migration, p95 back to expected range
DeployBot: slice 3/6 started and success
DeployBot: slice 4/6 started
DeployBot: slice 4/6 warning: KVCACHE eviction spike 22% for 6m, flagging as early-warning
Lina Torres: Holding slices until eviction stabilizes. No automatic rollback yet per criteria.
Priya Nair: Priming cache and adjusting prefetch window, monitoring now.
DeployBot: eviction rate dropping, slice-4 metrics trending to baseline
DeployBot: slice 4/6 recovered, resuming rollout
DeployBot: slice 5/6 success
DeployBot: slice 6/6 success. Rollout complete: 6/6 slices OK.
DeployBot: final status: tenant=argos-thera version_pinned=v4.0.1 rollback_mode=manual-only until 05:30 UTC per canary policy
Lina Torres: Manual rollback disabled until 05:30 UTC. For any post-rollout anomalies open an incident and loop SRE+Product. Final release notes and postmortem will be attached to the confluence page. Thanks all. :rocket:
